stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 14.

Because being connected—really connected, with the place you're in and the people you're with—requires disconnecting, at least temporarily, from everywhere else.

Based on this sentence, the reader can conclude that —

options.label: F
options.text: the Himalaya is a difficult place for disconnecting from the modern world

options.label: G
options.text: making a real connection in the modern world demands effort

options.label: H
options.text: the impulse to be connected to others is a modern phenomenon

options.label: J
options.text: modern society does not value connectedness
